# Daniel Felipe Montenegro

> The personal website of Daniel Felipe Montenegro, a Systems and Computer Engineer from the Universidad Nacional de Colombia and an AI software developer: his projects, his writing, and the spaces where he keeps what he loves (cinema, music, literature, faith, and more). It is his only home on the internet: he uses no social networks.

## Who he is

- [Everything Roz knows about him, and how she answers](https://montenegrodanielfelipe.com/roz-remember/): the notes behind Roz, the assistant of this site, kept so that they outlive her. The most complete account of him in one place.
- [About](https://montenegrodanielfelipe.com/about/): who he is, in his own words.
- [Thoughts](https://montenegrodanielfelipe.com/thoughts/): an open diary of one-line thoughts.

## What he makes and writes

## Talk to him

- [Roz](https://roz.montenegrodanielfelipe.com), his assistant, answers questions about him.
- [Telegram](https://t.me/dafmontenegro) is the easiest way to reach him.
